Breakpoints.Advisor: Allocation Tab - Spaghetti/Counterfeit % to 0; Adventure Tab - Turn on Combat (Target: A Very Strange Place, Idle Mode, Allow Fallthrough -> Optionally enable ITOPOD after unlocking TM to get some PP); Gold Tab - Turn on CBlock Mode
Breakpoints.Comment: ALLOCATION profile, not a challenge queue - the Challenges array is deliberately empty. LscAdvisor owns Laser Sword and redirects an already-scheduled rebirth into it, so select this profile to have the right allocation, gear and rebirth plan in place WHILE the advisor takes you through those runs. LSC is the only challenge that does not reset the number, which is what the Number 100000 target is for.
Breakpoints.Comment2: Put low targets on AT-0/1/2 and put high or infinite targets on AT-3/4. If we run long enough to unlock AT that means we need to focus on Wandoos for power (ie: NORB, NOTM, NOAUG, etc)
Breakpoints.CommentForNORB: Make sure to EAT the Yggdrasil Power fruit

Gear.Comment: Balance TM, Wandoos, BR and Augs
